title: <!-- PASTE THIS BLOCK AT THE VERY END

messages.content:
<!-- PASTE THIS BLOCK AT THE VERY END OF YOUR EXISTING "World Cup On Top" PROMPT.
     It extends the brief above. It overrides ONE thing: the output is no longer
     Notion-only — you now ALSO build a print-ready PDF. Everything else (research
     depth, sourcing, cross-checking against FIFA) stays exactly as written above. -->

=== EXTENSION: MULTI-PAGE PDF + ONE DEDICATED PAGE PER TEAM ===

In ADDITION to the Notion page, build a second deliverable: a print-ready,
magazine-grade PDF named "World Cup On Top.pdf". This PDF is the showcase. It
must be beautiful, modern, badge-driven, and COMPLETE — every team gets its own
full page. Use as many pages as the data needs. NEVER compress a team onto a
shared page or shrink content to fit. If a team overflows, spill to a second
page. "As many pages as needed" is a hard requirement, not a suggestion.

Use the SAME researched data for both the Notion page and the PDF so they can
never disagree. Do all research first (per the steps above), then render both.

--- OUTPUT FORMAT (how to build the PDF) ---

- Build it as a single styled HTML document with embedded CSS, then render to PDF
  (headless browser / print-to-PDF / weasyprint — whatever produces the cleanest
  result). Do NOT hand-place a bland default layout.
- Use print CSS: A4 page size, consistent margins (~18mm), and a repeating header
  + footer on every page showing: "World Cup On Top" · "Data as of <today's date>"
  · page number.
- Force a page break BEFORE every team page (CSS `break-before: page`). No team
  may be split awkwardly across a card boundary.
- No placeholder or invented data. If a stat is unavailable after cross-checking
  2+ sources, render it as "—" and note the gap in the Methodology page.

--- DESIGN SYSTEM (modern, clean, confident) ---

TYPOGRAPHY (one sans family, e.g. Inter / Helvetica Neue):
- Cover title 40–48pt bold · Page title 28–32pt bold · Section H2 20pt
- Stat-card number 24pt bold · Labels 9–10pt UPPERCASE, letter-spaced
- Body text 10–11pt — keep it to an absolute minimum

PALETTE:
- Base: off-white background (#FAFAFA), ink text (#111)
- Chrome accent: pitch green (#0B6B3A)
- Semantic: green = good / win, amber = neutral / draw, red = bad / loss
- Each team's HEADER BAND is tinted with that nation's flag colors (subtle, not
  garish) so every page feels distinct at a glance

SPACING: generous. ~24px gutters. Let cards and tables breathe. Whitespace is a
feature, not wasted space.

--- BADGE & TAG LIBRARY (use these CONSISTENTLY on every page) ---

- STATUS PILL (rounded, colored, bold): 🏆 CHAMPION (gold) · ✅ QUALIFIED (green)
  · ⏳ IN CONTENTION (amber) · ❌ ELIMINATED (muted gray)
- FORM CHIP (22px square, white letter centered): W = green · D = amber · L = red
- STAT TILE (rounded card: small icon + big number + tiny uppercase label).
  Color the number green/red when clearly good/bad (e.g. negative GD = red)
- GROUP TAG + FIFA-RANK TAG: small monochrome pills in the header band
- WIN-PROBABILITY BAR: horizontal track + gradient fill + bold % label
- MICRO-BADGES: ⚽ ×N (goals) · 🅰️ ×N (assists) · 🟡 ×N · 🔴 ×N
- Rule: any number that CAN be a pill / chip / tile / bar SHOULD be one. Minimize
  raw paragraph text — badges and tables do the talking.

--- GLOBAL PDF PAGE ORDER ---

1. COVER PAGE — full-bleed. "World Cup On Top" + subtitle (tournament · host ·
   current stage) + one hero number (e.g. total goals) + today's date.
2. CONTENTS — anchored list of every section AND every team page.
3. TOURNAMENT SNAPSHOT — the six-number dashboard as a row of stat tiles.
4. HOST CITIES & STADIUMS — clean grid/table, capacities as badges.
5. GROUP STANDINGS — one styled table per group; status pills inline; qualified
   teams bold; eliminated struck through.
6. KNOCKOUT BRACKET — only if reached. Clean bracket, scores, winners bold.
   Skip entirely if still in group stage.
7. === PER-TEAM PAGES === one full page each (template below). Order: in-
   contention teams first by win probability (highest → lowest), then eliminated
   teams by final standing. EVERY team appears — none skipped.
8. TOP SCORERS — leaderboard table, Golden Boot leader highlighted, ⚽ /
   penalty / 🅰️ badges.
9. ASSIST & DISCIPLINE LEADERS — top assists, most 🟡, most 🔴, missed penalties.
10. TEAM STATS MASTER TABLE — all teams, sorted by points (or goals if past
    group stage).
11. WIN PROBABILITY RANKING — headline page. Top-3 favorites as large cards with
    % + gradient bars, then the full ranked table. One-line note on what the %
    is based on.
12. UPCOMING FIXTURES — next round only. 📅 "Next up" callout highlighted on top.
13. METHODOLOGY — sources, data date, "estimates not guarantees," cross-checked
    vs FIFA, and any "—" data gaps listed.

Divider/section break between every major section.

--- PER-TEAM PAGE TEMPLATE (repeat for EVERY team, minimum one full page each) ---

HEADER BAND (tinted with national colors):
- 🏳️ flag emoji + TEAM NAME (large)
- Right side: [Group tag] [FIFA-rank tag] [Status pill]

HERO ROW:
- Win Probability: big % + gradient bar
- Form strip: W/D/L chips for last 3 matches (or all matches played)

STAT TILE GRID (icon + number + label tiles):
- GP · GF · GA · GD · Clean Sheets · Possession % · Pass Acc % · Fouls ·
  🟡 Yellows · 🔴 Reds · Pens Scored · Pens Missed

KEY PLAYER CALLOUT:
- Name · position · one line on why they're the key player · their ⚽ / 🅰️ this
  tournament

TEAM TOP SCORERS (mini table): Player | ⚽ | 🅰️ | Minutes

MATCH-BY-MATCH (this team only, reverse chronological):
  Date | Opponent | Score | [Result chip W/D/L] | Scorers | Stadium

FORM / TACTICAL NOTE: 1–2 lines maximum.

Footer: page number + team name.

--- HARD RULES ---

- One team = at least one full dedicated page. Overflow → next page. Never shrink.
- Page break before each team. No card split mid-element.
- Every qualifying AND eliminated team gets a page.
- Cross-check goal scorers & standings across 2+ sources; on conflict, FIFA wins.
- Notion page and PDF must carry identical data.
- Never invent a stat — unavailable = "—" + logged in Methodology.

--- ADD TO "WHEN DONE" ---

Also report: total PDF page count, and confirm that EVERY team has its own
dedicated page. Save the file as "World Cup On Top.pdf".
